sections.description:
⚠️ This plugin is being discontinued. We recommend switching to Echo Knowledge Base which includes a free, more powerful AI Chat.

Features not available in KB AI Chat: FAQs in the chat widget, article search in the chat widget, and direct contact form in the chat widget.

Free KB AI Chat features:
* Built-in ChatGPT and Google Gemini support
* AI training from your KB articles
* Source citations in AI responses
* Chat history and analytics
* AI Smart Search

PRO features:
* Agent Handoff and Feedback
* Email Notifications
* PDF Training Data

Learn more about Echo Knowledge Base.

✅ AI Chat Integration

AI Chat can answer questions based on content from your Knowledge Base, FAQs, internal documentation, notes, pages, or any other information source.

73 % fewer repeat tickets (our own numbers)
After enabling AI Chat, we saw a 73 percent drop in repetitive questions response times shrank, customers got answers faster, and the team could finally tackle higher-value projects without hiring extra staff.

Why Customers Love It

  • Answers in Seconds, Day or Night
    The bot reads your KB articles, FAQs, pages, and internal notes, then delivers clear replies before a ticket ever lands in your inbox.
  • Set-Up in a Coffee Break
    A guided wizard walks you from install to “live” in under 30 minutes. No coding, no APIs, no fuss.
  • Visible ROI, Fast
    Most teams cut repeat questions by the first week freeing staff for revenue-generating work instead of copy-and-paste responses.

Built-In Extras

  • Content Gap Alerts – Flags missing or outdated KB articles so you fix an issue once and never hear about it again.
  • Pain-point analytics – Real-time dashboards surface the topics that frustrate users the most, turning support data into a product roadmap.
  • Smart learning – As you update or add content, the model re-indexes automatically, keeping answers accurate without manual re-training.
  • Intelligent Agent Handover – Multiple triggers ensure users get human help when needed:
    • Keyword Detection: Automatically offers agent support when users mention terms like “human”, “agent”, or “support”
    • Sentiment Analysis: Detects frustrated users through thumbs down feedback and offers immediate human assistance
    • Always-On Option: Display a persistent “Talk to Agent” button for instant human connection
  • Powered by AI Engine, the leading WordPress AI plugin that also drives site-wide content and image generation.

Intelligent Agent Handover Features

Our smart handover system ensures no customer gets stuck:

  • Multi-Trigger System – Detects when users need human help through keywords, negative feedback, or manual request
  • One-Click Setup – Configure agent buttons, keywords, and routing in minutes
  • Custom Workflows – Route to different teams based on keywords or customer type (beta)

Our AI integration is powered by AI Engine, the leading WordPress AI plugin, which supports not only your chat but also site editing and image generation needs.

Result: fewer tickets, happier users, and support staff who finally have time for the work that moves your business forward.

For detailed setup instructions, visit our AI Chat Integration Guide

✅ Contact Form

  • Add contact form to any page
  • Get instant email notifications for inquiries
  • Track which pages generate inquiries
  • Ensure no customer question goes unanswered

✅ FAQs

  • Create custom questions and answers
  • Display FAQs on any page
  • Share FAQs across multiple pages
  • Customize content for individual pages

✅ Search

  • Search FAQs and documentation
  • Integrate with Echo Knowledge Base
  • Search posts and custom post types
  • Quick access to relevant content

✅ Contact Options

  • Add phone support link
  • Include custom URL links
  • Multiple contact methods
  • Easy access to support

✅ Customization

  • Match your website’s branding
  • Customize widget appearance
  • Adjust colors and styles
  • Flexible design options

See the AI Chat in action. Open it in the right bottom corner of our website: AI Chat Demo

⭐ How Will AI Chat Assist My Customers?

  • Your customers can get instant answers to their questions through AI Chat, Phone, or FAQs.
  • The AI Chat assistant provides 24/7 automated support by learning from your knowledge base and documentation.
  • AI Chat widget provides FAQs, search, and a contact form.
  • The contact form is available for user queries and issue submissions.
  • Easy-to-find support questions can be displayed on any page.

⭐ KEY FEATURES

  • Quick, five-minute setup.
  • Intelligent agent handover with keyword detection and sentiment analysis.
  • Full conversation context preserved during agent transfers.
  • A lightweight and customizable widget that works great with your branding.
  • Supports RTL and WCAG accessibility.
  • Responsive design that works with any theme.

⭐ WHY CHOOSE AI CHAT WIDGET?

  • Innovative features and ongoing improvements
  • Friendly and timely 24/7 support
  • Integrated with Echo Knowledge Base
  • Unlimited AI Chat widgets and FAQs

See our AI Chat documentation here

sections.installation:
Help Dialog AI Chat can be installed through your WordPress Dashboard or manually via FTP. Before installation, ensure your server meets these requirements:
* WordPress 5.2 or higher
* PHP 5.6 or higher
* At least 50MB of available disk space
* Modern web browser with JavaScript enabled

Option 1: Install via WordPress Dashboard (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. In the search box, type “Help Dialog”
  4. Look for “Help Dialog with AI Chat, FAQs, Search, Contact Form” by echoplugins
  5. Click “Install Now” and wait for the installation to complete
  6. Click “Activate” to enable the plugin
  7. Go to Help Dialog Chat → Need Help to configure your settings

Option 2: Manual Installation via FTP

  1. Download the plugin zip file (help-dialog.zip) from the plugin page
  2. Extract the zip file to your computer
  3. Connect to your web server using an FTP client
  4. Navigate to your WordPress installation’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  5. Upload the extracted ‘help-dialog’ folder to this directory
  6. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  7. Go to Plugins → Installed Plugins
  8. Find “Help Dialog” and click “Activate”
  9. Configure the plugin in Help Dialog Chat → Need Help

Post-Installation Steps

  1. Configure your AI Chat settings:

    • Set up your knowledge base connection
    • Customize chat appearance
    • Configure initial greeting message

  2. Create your first FAQ:

    • Go to Help Dialog → FAQs
    • Click “Add New FAQ”
    • Enter your question and answer
    • Set visibility and display options

  3. Customize your widget:

    • Choose display location
    • Set up contact options
    • Configure search settings

For detailed configuration instructions, visit our documentation.
sections.faq:
What is Help Dialog Chat?

Help Dialog Chat is an AI-powered support solution that combines chat functionality, FAQs, search capabilities, and contact forms to provide comprehensive customer support on your WordPress website.

What are the main features of Help Dialog Chat?

  • AI-powered chat assistant that learns from your content
  • Customizable FAQ system
  • Integrated search functionality
  • Contact form with email notifications
  • Phone support integration
  • Custom link options
  • Responsive design
  • RTL language support
  • WCAG accessibility compliance

Do I need any special technical knowledge to use Help Dialog Chat?

No, Help Dialog Chat is designed to be user-friendly. The installation process is straightforward, and the admin interface is intuitive. Basic WordPress knowledge is sufficient to get started.

Can I customize the appearance of the chat widget?

Yes, Help Dialog Chat offers extensive customization options:
* Match your website’s color scheme
* Adjust widget size and position
* Customize button styles
* Modify chat window appearance
* Change icons and branding elements

Is Help Dialog Chat compatible with my theme?

Help Dialog Chat is designed to work with any WordPress theme. It’s built with standard WordPress practices and uses responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across different themes and devices.

How does the AI chat feature work?

The AI chat learns from your:
* Knowledge base content
* FAQ entries
* Website pages
* Custom documentation
It uses this information to provide accurate, contextual responses to user queries.

Can I customize when agent handover is triggered?

Yes, you have complete control over agent handover:
* Define custom keywords in any language (e.g., “human”, “agent”, “support”)
* Choose between keyword triggers, feedback triggers, or always-on buttons
* Configure different actions for different trigger types
* Route to specific teams based on keywords or topics
* Enable or disable features based on your support workflow

Does Help Dialog Chat support multiple languages?

Yes, Help Dialog Chat supports:
* Multiple languages through WPML
* RTL languages
* Custom translations
* Language-specific FAQs

What kind of support do you offer?

We provide:
* Comprehensive documentation
* Email support
* Regular updates
* Video tutorials

For additional questions or support, visit our documentation or contact our support team.
